## Summary

Describe the user-visible or developer-visible outcome.

## Validation

- [ ] `bun run check`
- [ ] `bun run build`
- [ ] Relevant release-level quality gates, or an explanation of why none apply
- [ ] Documentation updated when support tiers or behavior changed

## Scope

- [ ] The change contains no unrelated files
- [ ] New behavior has normal and failure-path coverage
